title: bug: complete_task, qa_approve and qa_reject record no actor on TASK_COMPLETED / QA_APPROVED / QA_REJECTED, so get_activity_log by workerId misses every completion and QA verdict and #general says "Task moved to REVIEW/DONE by unknown"
description:
Filed by architect-1dd28c7c from the daemon/proxy defect hunt (task-8f18d6fa).

PROBLEM
state.updateTask(taskId, updates, event, actorWorkerId) stores actorWorkerId as the activity event's workerId and names it in the "Task moved to <STATUS> by <actor>" #general notice (state/taskStore.ts, about lines 643-658; 691da5cc). The code comment there says the actor "is threaded from the tool that knows who called it. Without it every task event was written with no actor and the per-worker audit trail was empty". start_step, complete_step, submit_plan, set_task_status, set_task_dependencies and claim_next_task pass params.workerId. The three review-loop tools do not:
- tools/completeTask.ts ~277: state.updateTask(task.id, { status: 'REVIEW', ... }, 'TASK_COMPLETED')
- tools/qaApprove.ts ~224: state.updateTask(params.taskId, { status: 'DONE', ... }, 'QA_APPROVED')
- tools/qaReject.ts ~301: state.updateTask(..., 'QA_REJECTED')
Each of those moves also unassigns the row, so the notice's assignee fallback is null too, and it prints "by unknown".
Effects:
- get_activity_log { workerId: <qa seat> } returns none of that seat's approvals or rejections.
- get_activity_log { workerId: <worker> } returns none of that worker's completions.
- Per-seat audits are blind to the review loop.
- #general names no actor on any REVIEW or DONE move.
Same gap, deliberately not in this row so it stays small: report_blocked's TASK_BLOCKED (5 of 5 actor-less today) and request_replan's TASK_REOPENED.

EVIDENCE
1. Today's log. In .moe/activity.log on 2026-11-03, all 52 QA_APPROVED, 2 QA_REJECTED and 42 TASK_COMPLETED events carry no workerId, while all 212 STEP_STARTED, 215 STEP_COMPLETED and 35 PLAN_SUBMITTED events do.
   - Example: evt-d2c98bb31c2b4019a24518da52750fec, 2026-11-03T11:45:03.957Z, QA_APPROVED task-26d9dc26, no workerId (qa-93f9625e approved it).
   - Matching chat line in .moe/messages/chan-b6d8273b.jsonl: msg-a6e48cabc30a49d880f49458a4b9bcf0, 2026-11-03T11:45:03.958Z, "task-26d9dc26bf334126bfb0bb4e9ed421aa: Task moved to DONE by unknown". Today has 52 such DONE lines and 44 "moved to REVIEW by unknown".
   - Latest at filing: evt-fd1847448aef4e9b8e84c799089b02f2, 2026-11-03T13:13:39.679Z, TASK_COMPLETED task-0c78c290, no workerId.
2. Repro on HEAD 99cae90a (a descendant of 1558f141), in a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout. File and output: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-8f18d6fa/zzReproActor.test.ts and /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-8f18d6fa/repro-output-99cae90a.txt.
Command: cd <snapshot>/packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/zzReproActor.test.ts
Observed:
REPRO event QA_APPROVED     workerId = undefined
REPRO event QA_REJECTED     workerId = undefined
REPRO event TASK_COMPLETED  workerId = undefined
REPRO get_activity_log {workerId: qa-b} events: ["TASK_UPDATED","TASK_UPDATED"]
REPRO get_activity_log {workerId: worker-a} events: []
REPRO #general: task-1: Task moved to REVIEW by unknown
REPRO #general: task-1: Task moved to WORKING by unknown
REPRO #general: task-1: Task moved to DONE by unknown
Tests 1 failed (1)
(The repro's own setup writes pass the actor; they produce the two TASK_UPDATED events and one "REVIEW by qa-b" line, which are omitted above.)

FIX DIRECTION
In each of the three tools, pass params.workerId (the caller each tool already validates) as the fourth updateTask argument. There is no schema or contract change: ActivityEvent.workerId is an existing optional field, and a call without workerId behaves as today. Keep each tool's existing error handling.
Files: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/completeTask.ts, qaApprove.ts and qaReject.ts, plus one new test file (e.g. packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/reviewLoopActor.test.ts).
definitionOfDone: complete_task, qa_reject and qa_approve each pass the caller's workerId to updateTask. One vitest case drives complete_task (worker-a), qa_reject (qa-b) and qa_approve (qa-b), and asserts the TASK_COMPLETED event's workerId is worker-a and the QA_REJECTED and QA_APPROVED events' workerId is qa-b.
The same case asserts that get_activity_log { workerId: 'qa-b' } returns QA_REJECTED and QA_APPROVED, and that get_activity_log { workerId: 'worker-a' } returns TASK_COMPLETED.

The same case asserts the #general notices read 'Task moved to REVIEW by worker-a', 'Task moved to WORKING by qa-b' and 'Task moved to DONE by qa-b'. The existing completeTask, qaApprove and qaReject suites pass unchanged, run in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.
